'''Burr Naxis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] working as a security squad leader for [[Marus Grayson]] to protect his [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] exposed at the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] before the auction of the jewel during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
